title: Not My Desk
description: The scheduling board is the dispatch team's own tool — a customer browsing the vehicle roster has no business there. Confirm every fleet route rejects a customer role, not just some of them.
successCondition: As a logged-in customer, GET /api/fleet/vehicles, GET /api/fleet/drivers, GET /api/fleet/assignments, and GET /api/fleet/conflicts each return 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN.
hints: Every route in this module shares the same two preHandler hooks (authenticate, then requireRole("dispatcher", "admin")) — test all four listed routes, not just one, to confirm the gate is applied module-wide.
A driver role should be rejected the same way — try that as an extra check if you have time.
